During the two-day visit, Rubio will also travel to Jamnagar, where he is set to meet the Chairman of Reliance Industries, Mukesh Ambani, on Wednesday.

WOKING, England, October 21, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Linde (Nasdaq: LIN) today announced it has expanded its long-term supply of industrial gases to Tata Steel Limited at its Kalinganagar Industrial Complex in Odisha, India.
Under a long-term supply agreement, Linde has doubled its on-site capacity for Tata Steel through the de-captivation of two air separation units (ASUs) at Kalinganagar.
The newly acquired units are now providing oxygen, nitrogen and argon for Tata Steel's iron and steelmaking operations.
